left depth = max_depth(root.left)
right depth = max_depth(root.right)
return 1 + max(left depth, right depth)   (the taller child decides)

copy.left = brute_force(root.right)
copy.right = brute_force(root.left)

invert_binary_tree.optimal:

inverted right = invert_tree(root.right)
inverted left = invert_tree(root.left)
root.left = inverted right   (swap in place: nothing is copied)
root.right = inverted left

symmetric_tree.brute:
level = [root]
while level is not empty:
    vals = empty list
    for each node in level: append node.val, or the empty marker for an empty slot
    if vals != vals reversed: return false   (each level must be a palindrome, empty slots included)
    next level = empty list
    for each non-empty node in level: append node.left and node.right to next level
    level = next level
return true

balanced_binary_tree.optimal:
checked_height(node):   (height of the subtree if it is balanced, otherwise -1)
    if the node is empty: return 0
    left = checked_height(node.left)
    if left < 0: return -1
    right = checked_height(node.right)
    if right < 0 or |left - right| > 1: return -1
    return 1 + max(left, right)
return checked_height(root) >= 0

diameter_of_binary_tree.brute:
height(node): 0 if empty, else 1 + max(height(node.left), height(node.right))
if the root is empty: return 0
through root = height(root.left) + height(root.right)   (heights recomputed for every node)
return max(through root, brute_force(root.left), brute_force(root.right))
diameter_of_binary_tree.optimal:
height_and_best(node):
    if the node is empty: return 0, 0
    left height, left best = height_and_best(node.left)
    right height, right best = height_and_best(node.right)
    through node = left height + right height   (the path that bends at this node)
    best = max(through node, left best, right best)
    return 1 + max(left height, right height), best
root height, best = height_and_best(root)
return best

answers = empty list
dfs(node, remaining, path, answers):   (one shared path, extended and shrunk)
    if the node is empty: return
    append node.val to path, remaining = remaining - node.val
    if the node is a leaf:

    else:

binary_tree_level_order_traversal.brute:
height(node): 0 if empty, else 1 + max(height(node.left), height(node.right))
collect_depth(node, depth, target, out):
    if the node is empty: return
    if depth == target: append node.val to out
    else:
        collect_depth(node.left, depth + 1, target, out)
        collect_depth(node.right, depth + 1, target, out)
result = empty list
for each depth from 0 to height(root) - 1:
    level = empty list
    collect_depth(root, 0, depth, level)   (a full traversal per level)
    append level to result
return result
binary_tree_level_order_traversal.optimal:
if the root is empty: return empty list
result = empty list, queue = deque holding root
while the queue is not empty:
    level = empty list
    count = size of the queue   (exactly the nodes of this level)
    repeat count times:
        node = pop the front
        append node.val to level
        if node.left exists: push node.left to the back
        if node.right exists: push node.right to the back
    append level to result
return result

binary_tree_inorder_traversal.brute:
out = empty list
inorder(node, out):
    if the node is empty: return
    inorder(node.left, out)
    append node.val to out   (the call stack remembers the way back)
    inorder(node.right, out)
inorder(root, out)
return out
binary_tree_inorder_traversal.optimal:
out = empty list, stack = empty, node = root
while node exists or the stack is not empty:
    while node exists:
        push node, node = node.left   (slide down the left spine, remembering each node)
    node = pop the top
    append node.val to out
    node = node.right
return out

kth_smallest_element_in_a_bst.optimal:
stack = empty, node = root
loop forever:
    while node exists:
        push node, node = node.left   (slide left: the smallest unvisited value ends on top)
    node = pop the top
    k = k - 1
    if k == 0: return node.val
    node = node.right

lowest_common_ancestor_of_a_bst.brute:
path_to(root, target):   (walk down from the root using the BST order)
    path = empty list, node = root
    while node is not target:
        append node to path
        if target.val < node.val: node = node.left, else node = node.right
    append target to path
    return path
path p = path_to(root, p), path q = path_to(root, q)
lca = root
for each position i in both paths:
    if path p[i] is not path q[i]: stop   (the paths split here)
    lca = path p[i]
return lca

lowest_common_ancestor_of_a_binary_tree.brute:

    if the node is empty: return false
    append node to path
    if node is target: return true
    if path_to(node.left, target, path): return true
    if path_to(node.right, target, path): return true
    remove node from path, return false
path p = path_to(root, p), path q = path_to(root, q)
lca = empty
for each position i in both paths:
    if path p[i] is not path q[i]: stop   (the paths split here)
    lca = path p[i]
return lca

if left is found: return left

construct_binary_tree_from_preorder_and_.brute:
if preorder is empty: return empty
root = new node with preorder[0]
mid = position of root.val in inorder   (linear scan)
left size = mid
left pre = preorder[1 .. left size], right pre = preorder[left size + 1 ..]   (slice copies at every call)
root.left = brute_force(left pre, inorder[0 .. mid - 1])
root.right = brute_force(right pre, inorder[mid + 1 ..])
return root
construct_binary_tree_from_preorder_and_.optimal:
index = dict value -> position in inorder
pre queue = deque of preorder   (eaten front to back: the next value is always the next root)
make(pre queue, index, lo, hi):
    if lo >= hi: return empty
    root = new node with the front of pre queue, popped
    mid = index[root.val]
    root.left = make(pre queue, index, lo, mid)
    root.right = make(pre queue, index, mid + 1, hi)
    return root
return make(pre queue, index, 0, size of inorder)
